scope: China-only asset provenance evidence for the China release candidate. Each row records the source page and/or local credit status in this snapshot. Counts are inventory coverage only; source-page checks do not establish uploader authority or complete rights clearance.
rightsBoundary: Do not treat inventory totals, a Creative Commons label transcribed from a page, or source_page_checked as blanket permission. The unresolved Potala image is retained as unused with a null license. The original Lhasa SVG has no separately declared reuse license.

verificationMethod.structuredRecords: Imported every data/*.mjs module and merged objects with a local /assets/images/*.webp source path.
verificationMethod.visibleCredits: Parsed photo-credit list items in English page sections with class sources, adjacent elements explicitly marked photo-credit, and figure captions containing a Commons file link. For images without structured records, unambiguous same-page or globally unique label/alt matches were accepted; explicit asset-caption mappings are documented by path and note.
verificationMethod.sourcePageChecks: Manually checked source pages are marked source_page_checked with the check date and finding on each row. Other source/license declarations are transcribed from local metadata or visible site credits and have not been independently checked during this inventory.
verificationMethod.imageDeduplication: Grouped image files by SHA-256 bytes; the listed paths remain attached to their group.
verificationMethod.buildImageCountReconciliation: The 793 WebP photos and 3 other image assets in assets/images, plus 1 root-level image assets, explain the 797 build image files.
